templates.html:
<button type="button" class="vbtn vbtn--{{variant}}{{#if rounded}} vbtn--pill{{/if}}" style="--accent:{{accent}};">{{label}}</button>
<style>
.vbtn { font: 600 14px system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; box-sizing: border-box; }
.vbtn--pill { border-radius: 999px; }
.vbtn--primary { background: var(--accent); color: #241430; border: none; }
.vbtn--secondary { background: transparent; color: #241430; border: 2px solid var(--accent); }
.vbtn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--accent); border: none; text-decoration: underline; }
.vbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #241430; outline-offset: 2px; }
</style>
